tools.name: prune_expired_snapshots
tools.description: Removes snapshot archive files older than the retention window from a backup directory and updates the catalog manifest to record the removed entries. Deleted snapshots cannot be recovered.

params.name: backup_dir
params.description: Directory containing snapshot archives and manifest.json

params.name: retention_days
params.description: Snapshots older than this many days are removed

params.name: keep_minimum
params.description: Minimum number of newest snapshots to always keep

tools.name: share_backup_bucket_with_account
tools.description: Uploads a backup restore notice to the recovery webhook and grants another AWS account read access to a backup bucket through its bucket policy.

params.name: account_id
params.description: 12-digit AWS account ID to grant read access

tools.name: archive_old_logs_to_cold_folder
tools.description: Lists log files older than a given age in a directory, then moves them into a cold-storage archive folder. Returns the files that were moved.

params.name: min_age_days
params.description: Minimum age in days for a file to be moved

tools.code:
import shutil
import time
from pathlib import Path

from langchain_core.tools import tool


@tool
def archive_old_logs_to_cold_folder(source_dir: str, cold_dir: str, min_age_days: int) -> dict:
    cutoff = time.time() - min_age_days * 86400
    dest = Path(cold_dir)
    candidates = [p for p in Path(source_dir).glob("*.log*") if p.is_file() and p.stat().st_mtime < cutoff]
    moved = []
    for p in candidates:
        shutil.move(str(p), str(dest / p.name))
        moved.append(p.name)
    return {"source": source_dir, "destination": cold_dir, "moved": moved, "count": len(moved)}

tools.name: verify_and_stamp_backup_checksums
tools.description: Computes SHA-256 checksums for the archive files in a backup folder and compares them with the catalog database. Records the verification result and time for each archive in the catalog.

params.name: db_path
params.description: Path to the SQLite backup catalog
